versions.changelog: 默认返回最终采集结果，完善异步等待下载与安全恢复；修复空目标误执行、Quick Start、Token 配置和触发路由冲突，并补齐发布前自动化测试
新增能力路由与异步任务闭环，修复失效引用、Token 泄漏和 Skill 元数据兼容性
补全中文文档，更新目录结构

Initial release of dataify-google-maps skill.

- Triggers on user requests for "call Google Maps", "map search/location details", or explicit map search field mentions.
- Converts user queries into Dataify Scraper API form submissions using a structured confirmation workflow.
- Displays a complete Markdown parameter table before each API call, requiring explicit user confirmation for all parameter values.
- Strictly applies only documented default values from reference documentation; never substitutes examples or placeholders as defaults.
- Handles user credential requirements, instructing users to obtain and provide `DATAIFY_API_TOKEN` if missing.
- Runs the bundled Python scripts for both parameter preview and API requests, returning the full raw response without modification.
